name: Greven (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of white with narrow blue stripes along both edges, charged at the top with the city arms of Greven (a white ship on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Greven; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Greven arms — white ship on blue
